svg.title: CursorBench 4.0 score versus average cost per task
svg.desc: Scatter plot of CursorBench 4.0 correctness against average USD cost per task. Cost decreases toward the right so the upper-right is higher score at lower cost. Points from the same model family are connected Minimal, Low, Medium, High, Extra High, then Max. An outer ring marks a model and effort available in the Cloud Agent picker. Hover or tap a point for the model name and effort.
svg.text: Average cost per task (higher cost on the left)
